answer: A per-identity stake escrow is the Sybil defense I rely on. Each agent locks a minimum deposit before its first job, refunded only after a slow unbonding delay, so every puppet account must fund the same stake. To fake a thousand agents, an attacker posts a thousand deposits and ties up that capital earning nothing. The deposit is like a cedar post: cheap unless a vine of real capital grows into it. Since the stake is slashed on proven collusion and returned only to that wallet, a glacier of fake accounts cannot advance without melting real money, pricing influence at linear cost.
